question: Rajnikant Devidas Shroff was awarded the Padma Bhushan in the field of ______ in January 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Trade and Industry**__.

__
 
• **Rajnikant Devidas Shroff was awarded the Padma Bhushan in the field of Trade and Industry in January 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajnikant Devidas Shroff** is an **Indian businessperson** and is the **founder** and** chairman **and* UPL Limited*.

 
 
• In **2020**, he was ranked as the **93rd richest person** in **India**, with a net worth of **$1.5 billion**, according to **Forbes**.
 
• **Shroff **is the **only industrialist** to receive **Padma Bhushan **in **2021**.
 
• He is considered **India's** **Crop Protection King**.
